memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Stable hypothyroidism and epilepsy.
Symptoms: she reports no fatigue, weight change, heat or cold intolerance, and no seizure activity in the past month. Examination: vital signs normal, thyroid gland non‑enlarged, no nodules, neurologic exam normal without focal deficits.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.2 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; change since prior test +0.1 L.
Inhaler technique: not applicable – no inhaler prescribed.
Smoking status: never smoker.
Assessment: thyroid function adequate, seizure control good. Plan: continue levothyroxine 50 mcg OD, levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD; repeat TSH and free T4 in 3 months; review in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Subclinical hypothyroidism needing dose increase; epilepsy unchanged.
Symptoms: mild fatigue and slight weight gain over past 2 months, no new seizures, no aura. Examination: weight up 1.5 kg, thyroid non‑tender, no enlargement, neurologic exam normal.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.9 L (95% predicted), FVC 3.3 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; change since last test +0.1 L.
Inhaler technique: not applicable.
Smoking status: never smoker.
Assessment: TSH elevated, free T4 low‑normal; increase levothyroxine. Seizure control remains excellent.
Plan: raise levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD; keep levetiracetam and lamotrigine unchanged; repeat TSH/free T4 in 6 weeks; review in 3 months.

Assessment: TSH within target range, free T4 mid‑normal; seizure control good.
Plan: continue current levothyroxine 75 mcg OD, levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD; repeat labs in 3 months; review in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Mild over‑reduction of levothyroxine leading to borderline low TSH; epilepsy unchanged.
Symptoms: occasional mild palpitations, no weight loss, no seizure activity, reports feeling slightly jittery. Examination: pulse 92 bpm regular, thyroid non‑enlarged, no tremor, neurologic exam normal.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (93% predicted), FVC 3.2 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; change since last test –0.1 L.
Inhaler technique: not applicable.
Smoking status: never smoker.
Assessment: TSH slightly suppressed, free T4 upper‑normal; reduce levothyroxine to avoid subclinical hyperthyroidism. Seizure control remains excellent.
Plan: decrease levothyroxine to 50 mcg OD; keep levetiracetam and lamotrigine unchanged; repeat TSH/free T4 in 6 weeks; review in 3 months.
